name: region
description: Broad natural and cultivated geographic regions

entries.value: Rolling Farmland — open crop fields, hedgerows, mills, and scattered market villages.
Temperate Forest — mixed woodland crossed by game trails, logging roads, and clear streams.
Grassland Steppe — immense windswept plains supporting herds, riders, and seasonal camps.
Rocky Coast — cliffs, hidden coves, fishing settlements, and dangerous tidal caves.
High Mountains — steep passes, thin air, glaciers, mines, and isolated monasteries.
River Valley — fertile floodplains linking farms, ports, bridges, and competing towns.
Marshland — shallow waterways, reed islands, peat bogs, and paths that shift by season.
Dry Scrubland — thorny brush, red earth, seasonal rivers, and widely separated wells.
Island Chain — inhabited and wild islands connected by reefs, ferries, and piracy.
Ancient Woodland — enormous old trees, dim undergrowth, forgotten roads, and territorial spirits.
Volcanic Highlands — black slopes, hot springs, ash fields, and mineral-rich settlements.
Frozen Tundra — permafrost, low vegetation, migrating animals, and brief violent summers.
Salt Desert — blinding flats, buried ruins, mineral caravans, and almost no fresh water.
Deep Jungle — dense layered vegetation, heavy rainfall, colossal insects, and lost stoneworks.
Lake Country — broad freshwater lakes, wooded shores, fishing communities, and misty islands.
Badlands — eroded canyons, exposed fossils, little water, and excellent hiding places.
Wine Hills — cultivated slopes, wealthy estates, old cellars, and intense local rivalries.
Flooded Forest — half-submerged trees navigated by canoe during a long wet season.
Crystal Expanse — natural glass formations distort light, sound, direction, and magic.
Levitating Archipelago — floating landmasses connected by ropeways, flying mounts, and waterfalls.
Dead Magic Basin — a fertile-looking depression where supernatural effects abruptly fail.
Storm Belt — a coastal region battered by near-constant wind, rain, and electrical activity.
Mushroom Wilds — damp country dominated by giant fungi, spores, and underground settlements.
Shattered Battlefield — miles of trenches, memorials, unexploded magic, and communities built from salvage.
